name: client_status
description: Whether the RuneLite client is running and logged in, which account is logged in, and how long since the last game tick. Cheap; call this first if a state read fails.

port.description: Port the plugin is bound to on 127.0.0.1.

gameState.description: RuneLite GameState name, e.g. LOGGED_IN, LOGIN_SCREEN, HOPPING, LOADING.

msSinceLastTick.description: Milliseconds since the last game tick, or -1 if no tick has been seen. A large value means the client is at the login screen or frozen.
